title: Little Girl Katie with Pet Cat in Driveway, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet suburban black-and-white snapshot taken in September 1966, featuring a young girl named Katie standing on a paved concrete driveway or alley beside her home. Walking directly in front of her towards the camera is the family cat, annotated affectionately on the back as 'White Nose'. Katie is dressed in a dark pinafore dress over a light puff-sleeve blouse and Mary Jane shoes, exemplifying mid-1960s American domestic childhood.
